content.text: When the primary escalation assignee has an active out-of-office calendar block, the secondary assignee never receives the reassignment or page notification. The ticket shows secondary on the roster but notification_log has no rows for that user.

Expected: OOO on primary triggers notify_secondary with the same channels the primary would have received. Actual: the OOO handler only unassigns primary and leaves secondary without an event, so nobody is paged until a human notices.
Likely gap in the OOO workflow step: it updates assignee_id but skips the NotificationFanout call that create-escalation uses for secondaries.
